name: (01) Thaumaturgy (Path of the Levinbolt) — 1 Basic — Illuminate

system.description: You wreathe your hand or arm in arcing current, generating a dim light (and a two-Trait Intimidation bonus against mundane onlookers) or powering a small device for one turn per point of permanent Willpower you possess. Used offensively by touch, it deals two levels of lethal damage and stuns the target for the rest of the turn; it can also weld a single broken metal item shut with a minute of work, at the cost of a level of aggravated damage to you.
system.source: Clanbook: Tremere, Chapter Two: Inside the Pyramid
